method: The real-data Random Forest is rolled forward one year at a time using the previous scenario yields. A residual is independently sampled from the held-out real test residual distribution (clipped to its 1st–99th percentiles) to create a reproducible synthetic scenario.
limitations: Generated values are hypothetical scenarios, not official observations, current agricultural statistics, forecasts, or validated future outcomes. They are excluded from the real-data training set and real-data metrics.
